sentence: TiMem (Li et al., 2026) organizes conversations through a Temporal Memory Tree that enables systematic consolidation from raw observations to abstracted persona representations.

sentence: MemWeaver (Ye et al., 2026) consolidates experiences into three interconnected components: a temporally grounded graph memory, an experience memory for recurring patterns, and a passage memory for textual evidence.

sentence: SwiftMem (Tian et al., 2026) addresses retrieval latency through query-aware indexing over temporal and semantic dimensions, achieving sub-linear retrieval times.

sentence: ENGRAM (Patel & Patel, 2025) takes a minimalist approach, organizing conversations into episodic, semantic, and procedural memory types through a single router and retriever.

sentence: Zep (Rasmussen et al., 2025) employs a temporal knowledge graph architecture that dynamically synthesizes conversational and structured data while maintaining historical relationships.

sentence: A comprehensive survey by Zhang et al. (2024b) systematically reviews memory mechanisms for LLM-based agents, categorizing approaches by memory sources, forms, and operations.

sentence: LoCoMo (Maharana et al., 2024) introduced a dataset of very long-term conversations spanning up to 35 sessions with 300 turns on average, evaluating models on question answering, event summarization, and multi-modal dialogue generation.

sentence: PerLTQA (Du et al., 2024) combines semantic and episodic memories including world knowledge, profiles, social relationships, and events, providing 8,593 questions for evaluating personalized memory integration.
